cases.name: same identity/facts redelivery is a no-op despite changed observed time
same identity/different facts cannot overwrite the original or seal a turn
identity is source plus event ID, not a cross-session/global sequence
native duplicate append may resequence the same ID without creating a new fact
sequence ties belong to distinct source IDs and cannot deduplicate unrelated facts
progress watermark cannot discard an older but valid terminal
cancel/complete race preserves the first committed terminal in both orders
late success from an old attempt cannot finish the current attempt
partial streams remain drafts and failed turns have no formal reply
unregistered scope is rejected without committing a fact
retry requires a sealed earlier attempt and a fresh attempt identity

source: CloudEvents source+id identity design and accepted U01 native observation; no copied implementation
limitations: In-memory synthetic policy experiment; no product contract or persistence proof
Commit ordering stands for serial writer acceptance; source_seq records runtime order separately and resequencing is an audit observation
Native unassigned sequence=0 must be normalized at the adapter boundary, not silently treated as a committed sequence
No native Loop, Desktop, real model, physical power loss or production transcript used
